title: Hotfix ts in client package
body:
While extending a unit test I realised they weren't being run in `packages/client`.

I did some fiddling to get `jest` to compile/run `ts` unit tests, but struggled.

While running `tsc` I got some compile errors in `ts` tests, and fixed them.  But, I wasn't able to get `jest` to compile/run  unit tests in `ts` files.  I was falling over at type definitions - so I hadn't got it right.

Once we've got `jest` running the tests, I'm happy to step back in and fix any broken tests.  We should then modify the `package.json` so that the unit tests run in a build/test process.
